blocker.summary: Required Linux guest executor build cannot proceed because the selected aarch64 Lima guest requires the absent aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu Rust target; no compatible aarch64 Linux cross linker is installed.
blocker.details: The canonical exact-source external build ran cargo build --locked --offline --target aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu --bin substrate-lifecycle-linux and exited 101 with rustc E0463 for missing std/core. rustup target list --installed omits that target, rustc target-libdir is absent, and aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu-gcc, aarch64-linux-gnu-gcc, and zig are absent. This occurred before dev-install, signing, publisher bootstrap, guest pairing, lifecycle, intent, retirement, or any product mutation. Canonical IH/PM, Lima, sudo, source/remote, prefix, and baseline/restoration parity were reverified.
blocker.required_authority: An authorized platform-prerequisite change must install aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu Rust standard-library support and a compatible aarch64 Linux linker/cross toolchain, followed by a fresh evidence nonce/attempt.
blocker.handoff_prompt: On local macOS, provision the missing aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu Rust target and compatible linker under explicit platform authority; retain the protected sudoers sentinel unchanged; then dispatch a fresh EVIDENCE:R3-MAC-IMP-01 nonce to rerun the entire packet from source binding.
